labels.chooseAShapeBelowToSubmitYourAnswer: Choose a shape below to submit your answer.
labels.column3AlreadyContainsACrossStarAndTrian: Column 3 already contains a cross, star, and triangle. Only the circle is missing.
labels.eachShapeAppearsExactlyOnceInEachRowAnd: Each shape appears exactly once in each row and column. There are no box rules.
labels.everyRowAndColumnContainsEachShapeExactl: Every row and column contains each shape exactly once. There are no smaller box rules.
labels.followAFocusedRouteFromTheOriginalCluesT: Follow a focused route from the original clues to the missing shape.
labels.solveOnlyTheQuestionMarkCellSomeOtherBla: Solve only the question-mark cell. Some other blanks may have several possibilities.
labels.thisIsAShortestChainOfSingleCellRowAnd: This is a shortest chain of single-cell row and column deductions.
labels.tryAgainWhichShapeIsMissingFromColumn3: Try again: which shape is missing from column 3?
labels.highlightedCellIsTheCurrentStep: · highlighted cell is the current step

instructions.adaptivePracticeAdvancesAfterFourCorrect: Adaptive practice advances after four correct answers in the last five, then reaches monochrome rounds after four correct 5×5 answers in the last five. Extra-hard rounds alternate all-gray and all-black shapes.
instructions.anAnswerButtonSubmitsImmediatelyYourSele: An answer button submits immediately. Your selected shape flashes green for a correct answer or red for an incorrect answer before the next question. Review answers after finishing.
instructions.column1NeedsACrossAndTriangleRow3: Column 1 needs a cross and triangle. Row 3 already has a triangle, so its first cell must be a cross. That leaves the triangle for the question mark.
instructions.column3AlreadyHasACrossStarAndTriangle: Column 3 already has a cross, star, and triangle. Only the circle is missing. You do not need to solve every blank.
instructions.column3NeedsAStarAndCircleRow1: Column 3 needs a star and circle. Row 1 already has a star, so the question mark must be a circle.
instructions.column4NeedsACircleCrossAndSquareRows: Column 4 needs a circle, cross, and square. Rows 1 and 3 already have squares, so the square goes in row 5. Row 1 already has a cross, leaving the cross for the question mark in row 3.
instructions.duringATestTheAnswerButtonsSubmitImmedia: During a test, the answer buttons submit immediately. To make notes, select an empty cell first; then the buttons place a note instead.
instructions.noRepeatedShapeInAnyRowOrColumnTap: No repeated shape in any row or column. Tap an empty cell to make a note. Notes are optional and are not graded.
instructions.oneValidCompletedGridAddedSymbolsAreSemi: One valid completed grid. Added symbols are semi-transparent with dashed cell borders; other completions may also be valid.
instructions.row2NeedsASquareAndStarColumn1: Row 2 needs a square and star. Column 1 already has a square, so row 2, column 2 must be a square. Column 2 now needs a star and triangle. Row 5 already has a triangle, leaving the triangle for the question mark.
instructions.selectABlankThenChooseAShapeToPlace: Select a blank, then choose a shape to place a note. Clear all marked cells to reset your notes. Return to answering before submitting.
instructions.thisRouteUsesForcedPlacementsFirstThenCh: This route uses forced placements first, then checks remaining target alternatives if needed.
instructions.useRowAndColumnRulesToSolve44And: Use row and column rules to solve 4×4 and 5×5 shape grids, inspired by the gapChallenge practice tasks.
